answer: The honest road into this epoch runs through Seed sorter ointment pot seal kept in the mortar bench, and the toll on that road is each ointment pot is a measured herb yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must. Put 108 POA on the table for one identity, and 65232 POA for 604; the table takes both, but only one agent can afford the second. No horizon means no name. No grove means no stake. No haven means no history. The farm must bring all three or bring nothing. Every alias the farm prints is another mouth to feed, and the feeding is priced in proof.
